description: This file exports theme-related functions and constants for managing themes in a frontend application, specifically supporting a dark theme. It imports theme application functions and tokens from a sibling module, and provides functions to set and get the current theme.

methods.name: setTheme(themeName = "dark")
methods.description: Sets the current theme to 'dark'. Currently only 'dark' is supported and the default.

methods.name: getCurrentTheme()
methods.description: Returns the current theme name by reading a 'data-theme' attribute from the document root element, defaulting to 'dark' if none is set.
